title: PIEZO1 expression across human osteoarthritis contexts: reproducible research compendium
description: Portable analysis code, public-input manifest, frozen statistical results, figure source data, published figure images, software lockfile and automated validation supporting a multi-dataset study of context-dependent PIEZO1 expression in human osteoarthritis.
